title: python3 is not installed
advice: umu-run needs Python 3.10 or newer. Install it with your package manager.

title: No Vulkan driver found
advice: Proton renders through Vulkan. Install your GPU's Vulkan driver (mesa-vulkan-drivers, vulkan-radeon, nvidia-utils, ...).

title: GitHub is not reachable
advice: Installs and repairs download from GitHub. Check your connection, proxy or firewall.

title: Somnium Space is not installed in the prefix
advice: Run the installer with Somnium's Windows installer from somniumspace.com.

title: Unilux is running inside a Flatpak sandbox
advice: Proton's container cannot start from inside Flatpak without host access. Use the AppImage or the native package.

title: python3 is not installed
advice: umu-run needs Python 3.10 or newer. Install it: sudo apt install python3

title: python3 is 3.9, older than 3.10
advice: umu-run needs 3.10 or newer as python3 on your PATH. On older LTS releases this usually means upgrading the distribution.

title: Bazzite is an immutable distribution
advice: Unilux writes only to your home directory, so this should work. Reports are welcome either way.

title: No Somnium patch bundle is installed in this Proton
advice: Without it the launcher cannot sign in: stock Wine lacks the TLS client-certificate support Somnium needs.

title: Patched files from b1 were replaced
advice: Something (a Proton update, a manual copy) overwrote them. A repair puts them back.

title: The catalog has no patch bundle for ge:GE-Proton11-5
advice: Switch to a verified Proton, or build a bundle with `unilux patch build --proton ge:GE-Proton11-5` and test it.

title: Patch bundle b1 installed and intact
The patch bundle for ge:GE-Proton11-5 is untested
advice: It was built for a nearby Proton. If sign-in or video fails, switch to a verified Proton and report the result.

title: ge:GE-Proton8-32 is older than Proton 9
advice: Proton 8 and older cannot initialise VR. Pick Proton 9 or newer in the Proton settings.

title: OpenXR detection is replaced by manual settings
advice: These settings replace detection entirely. If you need them, please report your runtime so detection can handle it.

title: VR is not ready
advice: Start WiVRn and connect the headset.

title: VR note
advice: WiVRn or Monado are recommended over SteamVR.

title: TLS errors in the launch log
advice: The patched secur32/crypt32 are probably not in use. Run a repair.

title: Certificate errors in the launch log
evidence: 1 matching lines, first: 0024:certificate verify failed here
advice: The patched libraries are probably not in use. Run a repair.

title: Vulkan errors in the launch log
advice: Check the GPU driver and that Vulkan works (vulkaninfo).

title: The game could not reach the OpenXR runtime
advice: Connect the headset before launching and check the runtime sees it.

title: Proton's container failed to start
advice: Look at the line in the evidence; it often names a missing path or permission.

title: wivrn-server cannot run its compositor at realtime priority
advice: When the CPU is busy the compositor misses its deadline and the headset rate halves (90 to 45 or lower) for a while. Grant it once, then restart it: sudo setcap CAP_SYS_NICE=+ep /usr/bin/wivrn-server. A package update removes it.

title: The AMD GPU is not in its VR power profile
advice: VR load comes in short bursts and the default profile lets the clocks fall between them, so some frames miss the headset deadline. SteamVR switches to the VR profile itself, WiVRn and Monado do not. Until reboot: echo 4 | sudo tee /sys/class/drm/card0/device/pp_power_profile_mode, or set it permanently in LACT or CoreCtrl.

title: XR overlay running: wayvr, xrdesktop
advice: It is a second client of the compositor and takes focus from the game when shown. If slowdowns line up with it, close it to compare.

title: The game freezes every 30.0 s
evidence: last session: 4 freezes, the longest 310 ms
advice: Freezes on a fixed clock come from a timer inside the game (a periodic cleanup, a poll, a network or voice task), not from the GPU or the compositor. Note what you were doing and compare with voice chat or the microphone off.

title: The GPU idles during the slowdowns
evidence: last session: 3 slowdowns, 4 s in total, 38 fps during them
advice: Frames are late without the GPU being busy: the game's main thread, the compositor or loading (avatars, worlds, video) holds them back. Check the findings above first; a scene with many avatars on a 6-core CPU is the usual limit.

title: The last session pushed 2.5 GB to swap
advice: Pages the game touches again come back from disk, and the frame waits for them: freezes when loading worlds and avatars. Set up zram (zram-generator or your distribution's zram package) so swapped pages stay in compressed RAM, and close browsers or other heavy apps before playing.

title: yt-dlp cannot start under this Proton
evidence: last session: 5 YouTube extractions refused by PyInstaller ("Security validation failure: unexpected name of application's home directory")
advice: Somnium's yt-dlp.exe checks the name of its temporary directory, and stock Wine shortens it, so no YouTube video loads. Use a recipe with the pyinstaller-tempnam fix (the built-in recommended one has it): unilux recipe use recommended.

title: Freezes in the last session
evidence: last session: 4 freezes, the longest 310 ms
advice: Irregular freezes usually line up with loading: worlds, avatars joining, videos.

title: The GPU clock drops during the slowdowns
evidence: last session: 3 slowdowns, 4 s in total, 38 fps during them
advice: Power management lowers the clock just when frames need it. Use the VR power profile (see above) or a fixed performance level.

title: Somnium refused some video links
evidence: last session: 2 links refused with "Domain not allowed" in Player.log
advice: Somnium only plays links from domains on its own allow list; the player stays blank without an error. This is the game's rule, not Wine: use a YouTube link or a host the world's creator allows.

title: Some YouTube links could not be extracted
evidence: last session: 5 failed yt-dlp extractions, 7 of 9 video opens failed
advice: yt-dlp ran but could not read these links: private or age-restricted videos, or YouTube changed something. Try another video; if every one fails, Somnium needs a yt-dlp update.

title: The game freezes every 12.2 s
evidence: last session: 4 freezes, the longest 310 ms
advice: Freezes on a fixed clock come from a timer inside the game (a periodic cleanup, a poll, a network or voice task), not from the GPU or the compositor. Note what you were doing and compare with voice chat or the microphone off.

title: The GPU is saturated during the slowdowns
evidence: last session: 3 slowdowns, 4 s in total, 38 fps during them
advice: Lower the resolution in WiVRn or the in-game graphics settings, or hide distant avatars.

title: Slowdowns in the last session
evidence: last session: 3 slowdowns, 4 s in total, 38 fps during them
advice: Neither the GPU load nor its clock explains them, or MangoHud did not report them. They usually come from loading on the game's main thread: worlds, avatars joining, videos.

title: The last session pushed 1.2 GB to zram
advice: zram keeps swap cheap, but the kernel still evicted game memory. Close other heavy apps before playing; with zram, vm.swappiness between 100 and 180 swaps idle pages before the game's.
